title: heptapleurum divaricatum
intro: Heptapleurum divaricatum, commonly known as the "Divaricate Tree Fern", is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Pacific Islands, where it is valued for its therapeutic properties and health benefits. Heptapleurum divaricatum is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
